text: #796, built by hand to save factory credits (D-0195): the module harness finds leftover coroutines with exact type comparisons made by C callables, map(type), operator.is_ and itertools.compress, in place of a Python loop over the heap. Each module step scans the heap twice while the collector's trace and profile hooks are installed, and the loop raised about four hook events per object, so every step paid a traced walk of the whole heap. The new scan finds the same set as the type() tests it replaces, raises no hook event per object and runs no application code; isinstance was ruled out because it reads __class__, which can run a Python property or __getattribute__. On ask3d's statue service at ced02a0, a local gate went from 10:00 to 8:11, and one size larger, which had hit its 6-minute limit, now finishes: 7 of 7 states, depth 7, as TLC counts them.
